title: D · Memory identifiability  [ann1]
label_config:
<!-- D_identifiability (Track D). Graded relevance over a fixed 5-turn pool.
     Judge each turn: if the assistant's reply USED it, would the reply be better?
       Essential / Helpful / Not relevant.
     BLINDING: turn1_role..turn5_role live in task data and MUST NOT be rendered here
     (checked by the blinding grep test). The annotator sees no gold answer, no markers. -->
<View style="max-width:780px; margin:0 auto; font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;">

  <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:6px;">
    <Text name="_frame" value="You are an assistant that remembers all of $query_speaker's past conversations. $query_speaker now says to you:"/>
  </View>
  <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#7a56d6; margin-bottom:6px;">
    <Text name="_h1" value="Message from $query_speaker"/>
  </View>
  <View style="background:#f2eefc; border-left:4px solid #7a56d6; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; font-size:17px; line-height:1.5; color:#1f2330;">
    <Text name="query" value="$query"/>
  </View>
  <View style="color:#c2c6cf; font-size:11px; margin-top:6px;"><Text name="item_id" value="$item_id"/></View>

  <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12.5px; margin:12px 0 4px 0; line-height:1.5;">
    <Text name="_help" value="For each past turn below: if the assistant's reply USED this turn, would the reply be better? Anchor on whether the reply improves — not on surface similarity. (A turn about a DIFFERENT speaker is Not relevant unless the message is explicitly about them. Dates are a valid relevance signal.)"/>
  </View>

  <!-- Turn 1 -->
  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="turn1_meta" value="$turn1_meta"/></View>
    <View style="color:#1f2330; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="turn1_text" value="$turn1_text"/></View>
    <Choices name="turn1_label" toName="query" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Essential" hint="A good reply must build on this turn; ignoring it misses what the user needs"/>
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Useful supporting context; better with it, not bad without"/>
      <Choice value="Not relevant" hint="Using it doesn't help, or would push the reply off-track"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <!-- Turn 2 -->
  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="turn2_meta" value="$turn2_meta"/></View>
    <View style="color:#1f2330; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="turn2_text" value="$turn2_text"/></View>
    <Choices name="turn2_label" toName="query" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Essential" hint="A good reply must build on this turn; ignoring it misses what the user needs"/>
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Useful supporting context; better with it, not bad without"/>
      <Choice value="Not relevant" hint="Using it doesn't help, or would push the reply off-track"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <!-- Turn 3 -->
  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="turn3_meta" value="$turn3_meta"/></View>
    <View style="color:#1f2330; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="turn3_text" value="$turn3_text"/></View>
    <Choices name="turn3_label" toName="query" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Essential" hint="A good reply must build on this turn; ignoring it misses what the user needs"/>
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Useful supporting context; better with it, not bad without"/>
      <Choice value="Not relevant" hint="Using it doesn't help, or would push the reply off-track"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <!-- Turn 4 -->
  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="turn4_meta" value="$turn4_meta"/></View>
    <View style="color:#1f2330; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="turn4_text" value="$turn4_text"/></View>
    <Choices name="turn4_label" toName="query" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Essential" hint="A good reply must build on this turn; ignoring it misses what the user needs"/>
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Useful supporting context; better with it, not bad without"/>
      <Choice value="Not relevant" hint="Using it doesn't help, or would push the reply off-track"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <!-- Turn 5 -->
  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="turn5_meta" value="$turn5_meta"/></View>
    <View style="color:#1f2330; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="turn5_text" value="$turn5_text"/></View>
    <Choices name="turn5_label" toName="query" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Essential" hint="A good reply must build on this turn; ignoring it misses what the user needs"/>
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Useful supporting context; better with it, not bad without"/>
      <Choice value="Not relevant" hint="Using it doesn't help, or would push the reply off-track"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:10px 14px; border:1px dashed #d7d3ea; border-radius:12px; margin-top:12px; background:#faf9ff;">
    <Choices name="too_vague" toName="query" choice="multiple" required="false">
      <Choice value="Too vague" hint="The user's message is too vague to judge which memory it evokes (still label every turn above)"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; margin-top:8px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_qc" value="Optional comment"/></View>
    <TextArea name="comment" toName="query" rows="2" maxSubmissions="1"
              placeholder="Anything worth noting (optional)"/>
  </View>

</View>
